question: Should maintainers accept the three new public Plugin SDK subpaths and the broad fs-safe 0.5 replacement as the supported compatibility boundary after the strict current-main merge check?
rationale: The branch has recorded owner approval and substantial proof, but accepting new public SDK contracts and a cross-cutting security-sensitive dependency migration is a maintainer ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair choice.

options.title: Accept the documented SDK boundary
options.body: Approve the archive, root-walk, and secret-file SDK subpaths and merge after the strict current-main merge and required checks succeed.

options.title: Keep the helpers private
options.body: Request a narrower refactor that leaves these helpers internal and supplies another supported plugin boundary for the bundled consumers.

recommendation.title: Accept the documented SDK boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the archive, root-walk, and secret-file SDK subpaths and merge after the strict current-main merge and required checks succeed.
